meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把回复变成先给下一步、步骤编号、带时间估计的清爽格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果长回复总让你走神,希望每条建议都能立刻动手。
copy.tagline_en: Turn replies into numbered next steps with clear time estimates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long answers lose you and you want a clear next step every time.

howto.what: Claude 的回复会改成 ADHD 读者能直接行动的形态：第一行就是可执行的下一步动作，多步骤写成带编号清单，每轮重述当前进度，给出具体耗时估算，并把已完成的结果摆出来。不带开场白和结尾客套。
howto.when: 用 /i-have-adhd 调用后接管，包括写代码、调试、闲聊等任何对话；直到你说 “stop adhd mode” 才关闭。

say.text: /i-have-adhd 我卡住了，先告诉我现在该做什么
say.note: 回复第一行给一个能立刻做的动作
关闭 ADHD 模式，恢复正常回复

say.text: walk me through 这个改动，慢慢讲
say.note: 进入解释模式，仍不带开场白和客套

howto.what_en: Claude reshapes replies for an ADHD reader: the first line is a concrete next action, multi-step work is numbered, state is restated each turn, time estimates are specific, and finished wins are shown. No preamble or closer.
howto.when_en: Turns on when you invoke /i-have-adhd, then applies to any message — coding, debugging, casual chat. Stays on until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: /i-have-adhd I'm stuck — tell me what to do right now
say_en.note: First line gives one action you can take now

say_en.text: walk me through this change, slowly
say_en.note: Full explanation, still no preamble or closer
